in_sanskrit.name: Riku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Sun, Shining One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Riku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Riku is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rik', which means sun. It is a unisex name that signifies a little sun or a shining one. In Hindu mythology, the sun god is revered as a symbol of power, energy, and intelligence. Therefore, the name Riku represents these qualities and is considered auspicious for both boys and girls.
